The '''''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] design produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] to serve as part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|starfleet]] of the [[Fel Empire]].<ref name="SW:L0" /> It was succeeded by the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]], which was the result of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] forcing the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] to reverse engineer an improved version of the ''Pellaeon''-class.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Scythefront.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Pellaeon''-class compared to the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]].]]
The ''Pellaeon''-class was named in honor of former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]],<ref name="SW:L0" /> and drew upon the distinctive and classic wedge-shape of earlier times, made famous by the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower'']], [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator'']] and [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator'']] classes used by the navies of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Ancient Sith Empire]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|old Galactic Empire]] respectively.<ref name="SW:L0" />

The class was often used as [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] and combined certain elements from [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]] like the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class]] and earlier Star Destroyers like the ''Imperial''-class.<ref name="SOTG07" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
<div style="float: right">[[File:Legacy8.jpg|thumb|150px|A ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer fighting a [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class battle cruiser]].]]</div>
The ''Pellaeon''-class was considered one of the most powerful warships in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and noted as having unmatched weapon systems and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] components. With its sleek outline, it presented less of a target to potential enemies, while at the same time optimizing its shield protection.<ref name="SW:L0" />

The forward-sloping superstructure of the ''Pellaeon''-class also gave the main gun batteries excellent vantage points, more so than on the Star Destroyers of the previous centuries.<ref name="SW:L0" />

The class had slightly more armament than the older [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="SOTG07" /> Some of these guns were of a similar design to the [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9]] turbolaser batteries of the old [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SW:L17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref> The ''Pellaeon''-class also possessed an [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]], capable of pulling ships out of hyperspace.<ref name="L28" />

===Complement===
[[File:Pellaeon_class_hangar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A hangar on board a ''Pellaeon''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].]]
The class had a ventral hangar where starfighters and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] could land and embark from.<ref name="SW:L0" /> [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] would be stored in racks in narrow passages throughout the hangar area. Traffic control centers were located on either side of the main hangar opening, overlooking the area.<ref name="SW:L13" />

Its sloping profile allowed the ''Pellaeon''-class to be shorter than the ''Imperial''-class while at the same time be able to carry a decent amount of landing craft and small starships.<ref name="SOTG07" />

===Propulsion systems===
A reactor bulb protrusion was visible outside the ventral hull. It is not known if this was the ship's primary reactor or a forward, secondary one.<ref name="SW:L0" />

===Bridge tower===
The ''Pellaeon''-class had at least one conference room with a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projector table in the center.<ref name="SW:L8">[[Legacy (2006) 8|''Legacy'' (2006) 8]]</ref> Its bridge was styled similar to earlier warship classes such as the ''Venator''-class, with crew pits encircled by a command deck where ship commanders could view the ship's surroundings out of panorama windows.<ref name="SW:L16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref>

==History==
[[File:PellaeonvsScythe-LECG.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer exchanges fire with a MC140 ''Scythe''-class cruiser.]]
Thousands of years before the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] used a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|capital ship]] similar to the ''Pellaeon''-class during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="TORtl">{{TORweb|url=info/timeline/timeline1|text=Pre-game timeline on The Old Republic homepage}}</ref>

The ''Pellaeon''-class itself began its service over 100 years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="SOTG07" /> succeeding the ''Imperial''-class and was noted as going up against the heaviest [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] warships, including the smaller-yet-faster [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]].<ref name="SW:L8" />

After the betrayal of the [[One Sith|new Sith Order]] under [[Darth Krayt]], some of these ships chose to rebel and follow [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] into exile. As of [[137 ABY]], a number of these vessels were kept in orbit and close to his stronghold on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] for protection.<ref name="SW:L6">[[Legacy (2006) 6|''Legacy'' (2006) 6]]</ref>

Later in the same year, [[Darth Stryfe]] used a ''Pellaeon''-class vessel to search for Jedi refugees on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Upon feeling a continued presence after his troops returned empty-handed, he ordered the vessel to destroy the ruins of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]].<ref name="SW:L17" />

Some Pellaeon's fell into the hands of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] and were distinguished with its symbol on the sides of their dorsal hulls.<ref name="L42" /> Similarly, ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyers loyal to the [[Empire-in-exile]] were distinguished not only by the Imperial seal but by red markings as well.<ref name="leg47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Legacy_destroyer_palleon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Full blueprints.]]
In an interview for [[Star Wars Insider 89|''Star Wars Insider'' 89]], designer and illustrator [[Sean Cooke]] described the design of the ''Pellaeon''-class as a new way to look at [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]]. The original idea entailed not making the vessel incredibly long, like the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], but incredibly tall and with a cathedral-like aspect to the design. The refined design harked back to the original Star Destroyers, but with a "front plow" addition based on the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] sail barge.

While the actual number of guns on the ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer are currently unknown, the ship's entry in [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'']] lists a number of weapon batteries, which according to the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]], represent up to ten weapons of the same type per battery.

[[File:Capital_Bombarded.jpg|thumb|200px|[[The Sacking of Coruscant]], with a ''Pellaeon/Harrower'' looming above the cityscape.]]
An image of the ''Pellaeon'' was used to represent a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] bombarding Coruscant in ''[[Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'', as the ship's design had not yet been finalized at the time of the video's creation.
